description.value: Timberwolf Restaurant and Lounge is an upscale, family-friendly restaurant established in 2006 and located inside the Mountain Retreat hotel on Highway 99 in Squamish, roughly midway between Vancouver and Whistler. It serves a broad menu spanning all-day breakfast, lunch, dinner, pizza, and a kids' menu, making it a practical full-meal stop for cyclists on the Sea-to-Sky corridor. Walk-ins are welcome alongside reservations.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetched successfully and provides address (38922 Progress Way, Squamish, BC V8B 0K5), phone (604-815-4424 matching OSM), and a full menu confirming active operation. The menu explicitly lists a 'MEATLESS' breakfast and gluten-free toast substitution, confirming vegetarian/GF options. No bike parking, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, or water refill are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags. The website contains what appears to be leftover website-template content ('Join Xtra Coffee House ™', generic coffee descriptions) mixed with genuine restaurant content, which is unusual but does not undermine the real business information.
